title: Kitlers
summary: This article discusses cats that resemble Hitler, humorously criticizing them within the context of social and political freedoms.

blocks.markdown:
## Kitlers

We at Proud Magazine believe that political and social freedoms are important and all that. We also tolerate the whole New Wave Punk-Death-Zig-Zag culture and the politically-minded yuppies who try to impose their opinions on everyone every single day. But when house cats style themselves like Hitler to impress their friends, we view that critically.
